customPages.title: Maternity & Pregnancy Care Guide
customPages.subtitle: Complete pregnancy journey from conception to postnatal recovery under Dr. Anjuman Sayyad
customPages.metaDescription: Learn about trimester care, normal delivery preparation, diet tips, and monthly free checkups at Pacific Care Hospital.
customPages.content:
### Welcome to Pacific Care Maternity Hub

Pregnancy is a miraculous journey, and ensuring the health of both mother and baby is our utmost priority at **Pacific Care Hospital**.

#### Key Milestones & Diagnostic Care:
1. **First Trimester (Weeks 1-12)**: Initial viability scan, blood routine, folic acid supplementation.
2. **NTNB Scan (Weeks 11-13)**: Early chromosomal and structural evaluation using Color Doppler ultrasound.
3. **Second Trimester Anomaly Scan (Weeks 18-22)**: Detailed fetal anatomy check.
4. **Third Trimester Monitoring**: Growth scans, NST (Non-Stress Test), normal delivery birth planning.

> **Special Initiative**: Join our free consultation and routine checkup on the **9th and 10th of every month** for all expectant mothers!

customPages.metaDescription: Information for patients and visitors visiting Pacific Care Hospital, Fatehpur Road Sikar.
customPages.content:
### Visiting Hours & OPD Guidelines

- **OPD Timings**: 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Daily)
- **IPD Visiting Hours**: Morning 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM | Evening 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM
- **Emergency Services**: Open 24 Hours, 7 Days a week

#### Admission Requirements:
- Valid ID proof of patient/attendant
- Previous medical records / prescription files
- Cashless or private payment desk available at main reception.
